items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers the separate cause-and-extent assessment. A fair gross charge of €500, calibrated to case 20 and below the €3,000 cap, gives about €338 after allocating the single €500 event deductible pro rata.

Section 5.2.6(a) covers locating the porous spots; this estimate treats the flat rate as the detection service, distinct from the technician time billed separately. The two lines total an estimated €625 gross before deductible allocation, below the €1,000 shared cap; this line's €500 gross allowance becomes about €338.

Section 5.2.6(a) expressly covers on-site technician time, provided it is not already included in the flat rate under §7.1.8(c). At €50 gross per hour, €125 becomes about €85 after the line's share of the event deductible.
Section 5.2.6(c) allows one vehicle charge on the contractor's invoice despite the hourly unit shown. The €70 net cap is €83.30 gross at 19% VAT, or about €56 after deductible allocation.

items.description: Repair of two actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats ageing-related leakage as fracture damage only at the verified leaking sections; §9.1.1 does not make ordinary ageing alone a breach. Allowing €260 gross for localized sealing or renewal of both joints gives about €176 after deductible allocation.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.5 exclude sections not shown to be leaking, even when replaced during a covered repair. The positive figure is an indicative price only if covered, not an allowance for preventative work.
Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss standard, so a separately billed premium upgrade difference is not payable. The positive figure is an indicative surcharge only.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows the plumber's single vehicle charge because the visit was needed for the covered joint repairs, even though preventative work was also performed. An ordinary €77 gross charge is below the €83.30 gross cap and becomes about €52 after deductible allocation.
